specials.name: Aerial
specials.description: Fly over mountains, rivers, sea zones, and enemy territories

specials.name: Anti-Cavalry
specials.description: For each enemy cavalry unit, one anti-cavalry unit gains +1 attack/defense

specials.name: Archer
specials.description: Defending archers pre-fire before round 1 of combat, with a -1 defense penalty except when defending a stronghold or fortress

specials.name: Captain
specials.description: Grant +1 attack/defense boost to up to 3 units of the same faction and unit type (infantry, archer, cavalry, etc.)

specials.name: Charging
specials.description: Conquer multiple territories in combat path

specials.name: Ford Crosser
specials.description: Can cross rivers at a ford and bring up to 2 units with it

specials.name: Home
specials.description: Deploy up to 1 unit per turn in its home territory without a camp

specials.name: King
specials.description: Grant +1 attack/defense boost to up to 5 units of the same faction. Same unit type first; leftover slots go to other unit types, lowest values first

specials.name: Ladder
specials.description: Allows up to 2 attacking infantry to bypass stronghold HP and direct hits at defending units

specials.name: Light
specials.description: Cancels all terror in the opposing ranks

specials.name: Ram
specials.description: Roll against stronghold HP with siegeworks before standard combat rounds

specials.name: Stealth
specials.description: If everyone in attack has stealth, they pre-fire and cancel any defensive archer pre-fire

specials.name: Terror
specials.description: Force 1 defending hit in round 1 of combat to re-roll (capped at 3 applied per battle)

special_rules.name: Rings of Power
special_rules.description: Rings of Power sit in territories on the map. Each ring adds its power to the income of whoever holds it. A hero can carry a ring with them, and some rings boost the hero bearing them in battle.

special_rules.name: Evolving Territory
special_rules.description: Some territories change the power they produce each turn, rising or falling until they reach a set amount.

game_options.name: Shadow of War
game_options.description: Fog of war. You see units only in your alliance's territories and the territories one step away. Battles and moves elsewhere stay hidden.
